rawStorage: Native Meshy GLBs, thumbnails, task records and the submission ledger stay OUTSIDE Git in reference/tasks/meshy-game-replacement-20261029/assets/ (raw/<id>/<attempt>/native.glb, ledger.jsonl, DELIVERED.json).

conventions.files: plain glTF 2.0 binary (no Draco / meshopt / KTX2); new flat path <old-basename>-t25.glb (cache-busting); logical runtime keys unchanged

restoreNote: Every replaced runtime file is tracked at the pushed base commit; restore = record.restore.command (git show <base>:<path>).

usedDespiteFlag.reason: primary 2026-10-29: no more rerolls; fix the extruded label locally (radialClamp) or keep the old model. Fixed locally: the can silhouette is a clean cylinder again and the illustration reads as printed (review sheet review/props/base_item_beans.png)

transform.description: p_out = diag(S) * Ryaw * p_native + t (baked into the vertices; node transform identity). Meshy native: +Y up, front +Z.
transform.fit: uniform: height 0.11 m (old runtime height) -> 0.0801 x 0.11 x 0.08 m; world/pickups.ts fitItemModel fits ITEM_DIMS at runtime

frontCheck.method: native rendered orthographically (textured, unshaded, 160 px) from +Z/+X/-Z/-X; alpha-bbox crops of render and the original image resized to 48 x 48; score = IoU + 0.8 luma correlation - chroma difference - 0.5 |ln aspect|; Meshy front +Z kept unless another side wins by > 0.15
